provenance.primary_source: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA public record 2025; data/programs/va-2025.json (applications acted on = actions 1-5)
provenance.dataset: loan_type=3 (VA); action_taken in {1,2,3} = decisioned; reverse mortgages excluded; universe U-VA-2025-DECISIONED (provenance/universe-expansion-2025.md)

attribution.required_text: Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record (VA loans); historical aggregate only.

reproduce.api: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA Data Browser API, no key
reproduce.filters: Keep loan_type=3 (VA), action_taken in (1,2,3) as decisioned, reverse_mortgage != 1; denial = action_taken 3. The API has no reverse-mortgage filter: drop those rows yourself.
reproduce.note: outcome shares use action_taken 1-5 as the base; the denial rate uses 1-3
